declarations.coverage: Intentionally empty content scope. The factory workflow declaration governs work throughout this factory-profile repository, including tracker work that changes no files. .factory/config.json stays owned by its separate exact declaration.

Intentional empty project-file scope: remote configuration fixes own GitHub settings only. origin names lutzseverino/repo-standards, public and personal-owned; session gh has admin access. gh variable list returns no repository variables; REPO_CANON_RUNS_ON is absent and there is no organization owner to supply an inherited value. The requested adoption authorizes standard remote setup.

The root CLI is covered by repository-readme. pnpm-workspace.yaml identifies site as the only internal workspace with independent commands and maintained source. acceptance fixtures, examples, packaged skills, vendor and organizational directories are not additional maintained Projects.

candidates.reason: Acceptance journey and fixture instructions organize validation evidence; not an independent app, service, library or tool.
The private Astro site workspace is a maintained app with its own build, check, dev and deployment commands.

declarations.coverage: Drafted from manifests and workspace configuration by `discovery/draft-typescript-node-stack-scope.mjs`: one `package.json` per Project, included when it matches the stack's manifest facts and excluded naming its differences otherwise. A maintained workspace root package is a Project alongside its members; a shared-only root is not. Uncertain root membership stays unresolved. A root package without workspace members is a Project. Reviewed maintained root independently: package.json publishes the CLI via dist/cli.js, tsconfig.build.json builds src/, and root commands maintain that product. site is a separate web Project. Acceptance projects are synthetic fixtures, not maintained Projects.

candidates.reason: Synthetic parcel-queue acceptance fixture described by acceptance/README.md, not an independently maintained Project and not a workspace member.
Maintained published CLI with its own sources, binary and build/test commands, alongside site; meets all stack manifest and contextual rules.
Existing Astro website Project waits for the web stack per #326 and repo-canon#217 decision 11. It uses TypeScript 6.0.3 rather than 7 and has no validate script; excluded without changing its stack.
